platform_links.label: Store editor
platform_links.desc: Drag & drop visual editor, no code

footer.brand_desc: The premium e-commerce platform for merchants worldwide — a complete alternative to Shopify, BigCommerce, PrestaShop, WooCommerce, Odoo and Wix.
footer.cta_sub: Try Sellia free for 14 days. No credit card required.

hero.p: Sellia brings together a theme editor, integrated payments, multi-currency and 25+ global PSPs — for merchants everywhere. No code, no friction.

how.p: From sign-up to your first sale, faster than it takes to explain it.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.text: Sign up for free and set up your store in minutes with our onboarding assistant.

steps.title: Customize your storefront
steps.text: Choose a premium theme, add your products, collections and discounts — no coding required.

steps.title: Sell online
steps.text: Take your first payments, manage your orders and track your performance in real time.

features.h2: Everything you need to sell online
features.p: A complete platform, from building your store to getting paid — in a single tool.

create.title: Drag & drop visual editor
create.text: Build a premium storefront without touching code. Real-time desktop, tablet and mobile preview.

create.title: Premium international themes
create.text: Refined, customizable themes in your brand colors, designed for merchants worldwide.

create.title: Smart collections
create.text: Manual or automatic collections with dynamic rules on tags, price, stock and status.

create.title: Native responsive design
create.text: Every store adapts perfectly to mobile — where your customers actually buy.

sell.title: 25+ global PSPs
sell.text: Paystack, Flutterwave, M-Pesa, Stripe, PayPal, Payunit… Cards, Mobile Money and transfers with no redirect.

sell.title: Multi-currency & markets
sell.text: Sell everywhere with native ISO currency support (XOF, NGN, USD, EUR) and translation into 7 languages.

sell.title: No-redirect checkout
sell.text: A fully embedded buying flow — your customers never leave your store. Less abandonment, maximum conversion.

sell.title: Promotions & discounts
sell.text: Promo codes, percentage or fixed-amount discounts, or free shipping with automatic rules.

manage.title: Inventory & variants
manage.text: Per-variant tracking, low-stock alerts and multi-location management so you never run out.

manage.title: Multi-zone shipping
manage.text: Rates by region, country and weight. Conditional free shipping and automated parcel tracking.

manage.title: Customer management
manage.text: Customer profiles, purchase history, multiple addresses and tags for complete, personalized follow-up.

manage.title: Marketplace
manage.text: Launch a multi-vendor marketplace with vendor management, commissions and split payments.

grow.title: Real-time analytics
grow.text: Track sales, visitors, per-product conversion rate and buying funnel on an actionable dashboard.

grow.title: Sellia Assistant
grow.text: Generate product descriptions, SEO content and entire themes with Sellia's built-in AI.

grow.title: Marketing & automations
grow.text: Email campaigns, abandoned cart recovery and event-triggered automations.

grow.title: Smart alerts
grow.text: Automatic notifications for low stock, new orders and anomalies — by email or push.

psps.subtitle: Accept payments anywhere in the world — with no redirect

showcase.block1_h2: Run your store at a glance
showcase.block1_p: Track your sales, orders, customers and products from a clear dashboard. Real-time stats for fast decisions.
showcase.block2_h2: Build a storefront that looks like you
showcase.block2_p: An intuitive visual editor with drag & drop, responsive preview, undo/redo and instant publishing.
showcase.block3_p: Over 70% of online purchases happen on mobile. Every Sellia theme is natively responsive — your store looks perfect on smartphones, with a smooth checkout and no-redirect payments.

brands.h2: Endless solutions for every kind of brand.
brands.p: Get started fast with the essentials, or integrate, build and scale on our open platform — trusted by B2C and B2B brands alike.
brands.caption: Auto-scroll · 12 categories
brands.footnote: 100% responsive stores — desktop & mobile, independently configurable.

testimonials.p: Thousands of merchants around the world trust Sellia.

items.quote: I launched my wax fashion store in one afternoon. Mobile money payments transformed my sales — my customers no longer need cash.
Sellia handles multi-currency natively. My customers in Nigeria and Ivory Coast pay with zero friction, and I track everything from one dashboard.
The theme editor is intuitive and the themes are gorgeous. My brand image levelled up, and the AI assistant saved me hours.

flags.title: Available worldwide
flags.subtitle: Sell anywhere — Sellia is a global platform

pricing.p: 14-day free trial on every plan. No credit card required.
pricing.note_annual: Annual billing — 20% savings already included above.
pricing.note_monthly: Monthly billing, switch to annual anytime.
pricing.mobile_p: Your customers buy from their phone, anywhere in the world. Smooth checkout, no-redirect payments, Mobile Money and card support.

about.meta_desc: Sellia is the premium e-commerce platform built by Liafrik so any merchant can launch, run and grow an online store internationally.
about.hero_p: Sellia is built by Liafrik to give merchants everywhere a premium alternative to the big e-commerce platforms — more complete on local payments, simpler to use, and designed to sell internationally from day one.
about.mission_p: Give every merchant — from Abidjan to Paris, from Lagos to Montreal — the same premium tools as the biggest brands, without the technical complexity or hidden costs of legacy platforms.

values.title: A global ambition
values.text: Sellia is built to sell anywhere in the world: native multi-currency, Mobile Money and international cards in one platform.

values.title: Premium as the standard
values.text: Polished themes, no-redirect checkout, security and performance aren't paid add-ons — they're the baseline on every plan.

values.title: Merchants, not tickets
values.text: Every feature starts from a real merchant need, not a marketing checkbox.

values.title: AI at the service of commerce
values.text: Sellia Assistant generates content, themes and SEO optimizations so you can focus on your products and customers.

about.cta_h2: Want to join the Sellia adventure?
about.cta_p: Launch your store today, or check out our open roles.

contact.meta_desc: Get in touch with the Sellia team: technical support, customer service or social media. We reply quickly to every merchant.
contact.hero_p: A team available to answer your questions, before and after you sign up.
contact.channel1_text: A question about your store, a bug, a feature?
contact.follow_p: Product news, updates and behind the scenes of the platform.

careers.meta_desc: Join the Liafrik team building Sellia, the premium e-commerce platform. Discover our mission and how to apply.
careers.hero_p: Sellia is built by the Liafrik team. We're growing fast and always keen to meet talented people — even outside our published openings.

reasons.title: International impact
reasons.text: Your work serves merchants across several continents, from day one.

reasons.title: A fast-moving product
reasons.text: New features, new markets, new payment methods — the team moves fast and ships often.

reasons.title: A human-sized team
reasons.text: At Liafrik, every person counts and has a direct, visible impact on the product.

careers.spontaneous_h2: No open role matches your profile?
careers.spontaneous_p: Send us a spontaneous application — we read every message.
